summary: Pembina Pipeline filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results news release (US equivalent: an earnings press release on Form 8-K). Reported earnings of $570M ($0.92/share), adjusted earnings of $479M ($0.77/share), adjusted EBITDA of $1,128M, up 9% year over year, and adjusted cash flow of $751M. Guidance was narrowed to $4.45–4.55B with a trend toward the upper end. The board declared a Q4 dividend of $0.735/share payable December 31, 2026 to holders of record December 15. Operational updates included the Lator Infrastructure entering service, a non-binding Pacific Link participation agreement, and GLEC sanction. No transactional special situation; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
